name: Lightsaber Arena
desc:
⚔️ Master the Force and hone your abilities as a lightsaber wielder.

⭐ Check socials for future updates!

🖥️ CONTROLS 💻
Q = Ignite Saber
Ctrl = Mouse Lock
Left Click = Attack
Right Click = Block (Hold)
Middle Mouse Button = Saber Throw
Shift = Walk/Run
Hold Space = Flip
E = Slap
R = Dash
Z = Change Form

🔥 Inspired by Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy & Movie Battles II.

Lightsaber, Clone Wars, Vader, Kenobi, Ahsoka, Skywalker, Jedi, Sith, Fighting, Dueling

All credits and ideas based around the SW universe within the game belong to their respective creators and LucasFilm Ltd.
